<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666. The isotope pattern (significant M+2 peak) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Assuming this ion is the [M+H]⁺ adduct, the neutral mass is ≈275.059 Da. Subtracting the monoisotopic mass of ¹³⁵Cl (34.9689 Da) gives a remaining mass of ≈240.090 Da, which matches the formula C₁₂H₁₆O₅ (exact mass 240.0998 Da). Adding the chlorine atom yields the molecular formula C₁₂H₁₆O₅Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O5Cl</final_answer>
